DOpenVDBAnalysis

VdbInput connectable 1
add VdbInput
string.create
create SelectedGridNames grids string *
SelectedGridNames connectable 0
add SelectedGridNames
create Operator op enum 0
Operator field Gradient       (Scalar->Vector) 0
Operator field Curvature     (Scalar->Scalar) 1
Operator field Laplacian      (Scalar->Scalar) 2
Operator field Closest Point (Scalar->Vector) 3
Operator field Divergence    (Vector->Scalar) 4
Operator field Curl             (Vector->Vector) 5
Operator field Length         (Vector->Scalar) 6
Operator field Normalize     (Vector->Vector) 7
Operator connectable 0
add Operator
create MaskVdbInput maskvdb geometry null
MaskVdbInput connectable 1
add MaskVdbInput
string.create
create MaskGridNames mgrids string 
MaskGridNames connectable 0
add MaskGridNames
create OutputName onm enum 0
OutputName field Keep Incoming VDB Names 0
OutputName field Append Operation Name 1
OutputName field Custom Name 2
OutputName connectable 0
add OutputName
string.create
create CustomName cnm string 
CustomName connectable 0
add CustomName
create VdbOutput vdboutput geometry null
VdbOutput writable 0
VdbOutput storable 0
add VdbOutput
affects VdbInput VdbOutput
affects SelectedGridNames VdbOutput
affects Operator VdbOutput
affects MaskVdbInput VdbOutput
